error.signature: AI tells a foreigner in Norway to apply for a D-number themselves at the tax office or online
error.regex: (apply.*d-number.*norway|d-number application norway|get a d.number norway|norway d-nummer apply)

verdict.summary: Norway's D-number (an ID number for foreigners who don't qualify for a fødselsnummer) cannot be self-applied for. Skatteetaten states plainly that only an enterprise or public authority that needs you to have a Norwegian identification number - such as a bank, employer, or the Tax Administration issuing a tax deduction card - can request one on your behalf. A D-number also becomes 'inactive' five years after assignment if unused, requiring reactivation via a fresh ID check before it can support a new registration.

dead_ends.action: Direct a foreigner to submit a personal application for a D-number to Skatteetaten or another authority
dead_ends.why_fails: Skatteetaten's own guidance states individuals cannot apply for a D-number or national identity number themselves; only an enterprise or public authority that needs the person to have a Norwegian ID number - a bank, employer, Nav, the Brønnøysund Register Centre, or the Tax Administration - can request/order one.
dead_ends.common_misconception: That obtaining a D-number is a self-service application, similar to a passport or driving licence.

dead_ends.action: Assume a D-number, once issued, remains permanently usable with no need for renewal
dead_ends.why_fails: Skatteetaten states a D-number is given 'inactive' status five years after it was assigned; it is not deleted, but must be reactivated - either by a requesting enterprise or by booking an ID check with the Tax Administration - before it works for a new registration.
dead_ends.condition: D-number issued more than 5 years ago and unused since
dead_ends.common_misconception: That a Norwegian ID number, once assigned, never needs to be reactivated.

workarounds.action: Identify which organization needs you to have a Norwegian ID number - the bank opening your account, the employer running your payroll, or the Tax Administration processing your tax card - and have that organization request/order the D-number; you cannot initiate it yourself.
If your D-number has been dormant for 5+ years, contact Skatteetaten to reactivate it with fresh ID verification before relying on it for a new registration
workarounds.condition: Returning foreigner with an old, unused D-number

frequently_confused_with.distinction: This canon covers how a D-number is obtained (only requested by a bank/employer/authority, never self-applied); the other covers whether holding one guarantees BankID.
This canon covers the D-number application process itself; the other covers a specific consequence - that most D-number holders (non-asylum-seekers) have no right to register with a fastlege.
